prior_governance_evidence_summary.phase_a1_outcome: WIND_TARGET_STATUS = NOT_ESTABLISHED; WIND_DATA_STATUS = INSUFFICIENT; No local ground wind measurements at Mount Nuolja AWS.
prior_governance_evidence_summary.phase_a1_5_outcome: Acquired SMHI Station 188790 (Abisko Aut) continuous 1-hour 10m wind speed dataset for 2024 (8,784 records, 100% complete, CC BY 4.0).
prior_governance_evidence_summary.phase_a1_6_outcome: TARGET_DECISION = PROXY_TARGET_CONDITIONALLY_SUPPORTED; Established Abisko wind speed as a conditionally supported regional proxy for the Nuolja microgrid context.

mandatory_proxy_limitations: Abisko measured wind speed is used as a conditionally supported regional proxy for the Mount Nuolja research context; it is not direct measured Nuolja wind.
The proxy designation supports use of the Abisko series as the empirical forecasting target for this research track; it does not establish meteorological equivalence between Abisko and Mount Nuolja.

Prohibited Claims: Abisko wind = Nuolja wind; Abisko measurements are direct Nuolja measurements; 310m altitude difference has been corrected; Nuolja wind conditions have been empirically reconstructed; a validated Abisko->Nuolja transfer model exists; Abisko and Nuolja are meteorologically equivalent sites.

altitude_limitation.governance_rule: No power-law, log-law, or generic vertical scaling equation was applied or authorized. The target remains the actual measured Abisko 10m observation. Unresolved altitude difference remains a documented research limitation.

wind_speed_vs_wind_power_boundary.authorized_target_variable: 10m measured wind speed in m/s ONLY
wind_speed_vs_wind_power_boundary.governance_rule: No turbine power curves (IEC 61400-12-1), Watt conversions, hub-height extrapolations, or wind generation forecasting claims are authorized. Conversion to wind power generation requires separate representation/modeling decisions and separate governance authorization.

authorization_scope.authorized_scope: Authorizes ONLY the future research target definition: forecasting the measured 10m hourly Abisko wind-speed series as a conditionally supported regional proxy target for the Nuolja context.
